sentences.text:
Rajpal Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 January,
2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:824
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

At Jabalpur
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal
 On The 8 th Of January, 2025
 Criminal Revision No. 6442 of 2024
 Rajpal Singh
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Prakhar Naveriya - Advocate for the applicant.
 Smt. Shanti Tiwari - Panel Lawyer for State.

Heard this criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., 438 of BNSS has been filed by the applicant being aggrieved by the proceedings of order dated 19.12.2024 whereby applicant's application summoning of a defense witness has been partly rejected.
Hence, this petition has been filed for quashing/modifying the order impugned.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that respondent No.2 lodged an FIR that applicant had approached her and then taken her away her consent and further allegations were made regarding commission of sexual assault without her consent.

Therefore, Crime No. 331/2019 for commission of offences under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC,
3.
The matter was charge-sheeted and it was registered as S.T. No. 09/2020 before Additional Sessions Judge, Tikamgarh (M.P.) for its trial.
Prosecution witnesses were examined and matter was posted for defence witness and on 19.12.2024.

Thereafter, applicant also preferred an application for summoning two persons namely Ravi and Jagtar Singh as defense witnesses as Ravi was the Pandit who has performed the marriage rituals whereas Jagtar Singh was also present at the marriage ceremony.

Therefore, applicant preferred an application for summoning of defense witness but the said application was rejected by the learned Trial Court with liberty to the applicant that he can present the defense witness on his own.
The applicant specifically pleaded that he is unable to call the persons.

Therefore, it is prayed that the Rajpal Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107561512/
1 Court may be kind enough to issue summons to the witnesses.

sentences.text: 5. On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer for the State opposed the prayer of the applicant.

6. After perusal of record and in view of the aforesaid facts, impugned order dated 19.12.2024 passed by I Additional Sessions Judge, Tikamgarh passed in ST No.09/2020 is modified in respect of summoning of witnesses.
Learned trial Court is directed to issue summons to the aforesaid witnesses.
7. With the aforesaid direction, the criminal revision stands allowed and disposed of.
